'''Silverbacks''' were a [[Subspecies/Legends|subspecies]] of [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] that had [[Color/Legends|silver]] pelts. Their pelts were valued greatly by [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] hunters.<ref name="TOR" />
